company.name: Ello
company.shortDescription: Ello is an app-based reading coach that works with real books.
company.description:
Ello revolutionizes the way children learn to read by combining real books with artificial intelligence technology and, in so doing, gives each child their own expert teacher. Ello uses evidence-based reading instruction to help them when they get stuck and behavioral psychology to motivate them to keep going.

The company believes books are the portal to lifelong learning, and when children make a personal connection with a real book their natural, joyful curiosity flourishes.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Series A round raised $15,000,000, or 97.09% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.statement: 1 disclosed grants total $300,000, representing 1.94% of reported funding.
insights.implication: The grants reduce the share of reported financing attributed to equity or notes, although their restrictions and milestone requirements need separate verification.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $3,101,559 to $84,195,181, a 27.15x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.
